description: This file defines a test base class for media pipeline testing, including setup and teardown of mocks, creation and destruction of media pipeline objects, and methods to simulate state changes and data requests within the media pipeline testing framework.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A base class for media pipeline unit tests, providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for managing media pipeline mocks and state.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects for media pipeline components.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Resets and cleans up mock objects.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates and initializes a media pipeline object with mock dependencies.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Destroys the media pipeline object and cleans up associated callbacks.

methods.name: setPlaybackState
methods.description: Simulates a change in playback state and notifies the media pipeline callback.

methods.name: setNetworkState
methods.description: Simulates a change in network state and notifies the media pipeline callback.

methods.name: needData
methods.description: Simulates a request for media data from the media pipeline.
